messages:
maya_docs: Heads-up — I'm prepping a small docs PR to clarify retention behavior when a tenant is 're-homed' between accounts (SOC2/audit-log section). Wanted to sync snippets before I open the PR.
jon_security: thanks. do we have a canonical term for 're-homed' in legal language? might be 'tenant transfer' or 'account migration'. :thinking_face:
maya_docs: Good call. I'm leaning toward 'tenant migration' in docs, with a parenthetical 're-homing (transfer between customer accounts)'. keeps it readable.
liam_engineering: for the SDK snippet, we should show both the server-side flag and the API curl example. e.g., show TTL + a `hold_for_legal_hold()` call example.
sara_legal: prefer 'tenant migration' too. Also add a short note about legal hold requests — they supersede automatic TTL deletions until released.
maya_docs: ok. Draft snippet below — can you check technical accuracy, @liam_engineering?
```
# python
# mark a tenant for migration and preserve audit logs for 90 days or until release
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
client.audit.set_retention(tenant_id="acct_123", ttl_days=90)
client.legal.place_hold(tenant_id="acct_123", reason="merger")
```

liam_engineering: looks fine but two notes: 1) API is `set_retention_policy` not `set_retention` in the SDK v2; 2) `legal.place_hold` is actually `holds.create` and it returns a hold id. maybe show the hold id usage.
maya_docs: thanks — updating. will add both py + curl.
jon_security: one more: clarify that audit logs may be exported before migration and that export copies are subject to customer retention. also call out encryption-at-rest and export encryption. short sentence. :lock:
maya_docs: will add sentence and a tiny example of export command.
```
# curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_123","range_from":"2025-01-01","range_to":"2025-03-01"}'
```

sara_legal: wording suggestion: "During tenant migration, audit log entries remain subject to the retention policy configured for the tenant, except where a legal hold is in effect. Exports created prior to or during migration remain the responsibility of the exporting party and must be protected per contract."
maya_docs: perfect phrasing — I'll include that verbatim.
liam_engineering: also add a short note about redaction: default SDK export includes full events; we add a small example `redact_sensitive:true` query param for customers who want PII removed during export.
maya_docs: added `?redact_sensitive=true` to the curl.
docs-bot: link-checker: running link check on PR branch... :robot_face:
docs-bot: link-checker: 3 links flagged — one internal redirect, one missing anchor in /docs/security, one external vendor doc updated (link changed).
maya_docs: I'll fix the internal anchor and swap the vendor link to the new URL. assigning reviewers @jon_security @sara_legal @liam_engineering.
jon_security: quick review scheduled. can we also add a tiny FAQ bullet under SOC2: "What happens to logs when a customer transfers their tenant?" with 2-3 bullets.
sara_legal: yes include a sample sentence for contracts: "Customer is responsible for exports and must ensure exported data is handled per their obligations."
liam_engineering: LGTM on final snippet once SDK function names are corrected.
maya_docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — draft includes snippets, FAQ bullet, and export/curl examples. last_message_ts: 1765432165
